result.summary: This is a narrow residential street lined with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. The environment lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, and sightlines are significantly restricted by parked vehicles along both curbs.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the street block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers to potential pedestrian activity at the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow one-way residential street with sidewalks on both sides but lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure at the intersection. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian-specific signage, creating accessibility and visibility challenges.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the intersection makes the crossing inaccessible for wheelchair users and people with strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection in the foreground.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers to their presence.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway at the intersection.

interventions.title: Install ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct sloped curb transitions at all corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.
